newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber mostly flat in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber mostly flat in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mostly flat in thin after-hours trade on Thursday, as most private investors retreated to the sidelines amid a lack of fresh incentives, traders said.
Prices ranged from flat to 0.1 yen per kg lower than the day's close. Benchmark May was unchanged at 144.5 yen.
During the day, the market started the day weaker, reflecting the yen's firmer tendency against the dollar.
"Prices are likely to be trapped within tight ranges ahead of the spot expiry next Friday," one trader said.
